description: Points a brand's domain at its Peptide Scientifix storefront: an A record to the storefront server and a TXT record that proves ownership. Group main is always applied; group www (a CNAME from www to the domain) is applied only when the template is applied to an apex domain (groupId=main,www).
variableDescription: %ip% is the storefront server's IPv4 address. %token% is the per-domain verification code the portal shows; the platform reads it back at _psx-verify.<host>.
